_note: Fixed, published outlet list. Lean is never set by hand: each outlet's side is computed in code from the 'pew' numbers, copied exactly from Pew Research Center's News Media Tracker (survey of 9,482 U.S. adults, March 10-16, 2025): the % of Republicans/lean Republican and the % of Democrats/lean Democrat who regularly get news from the outlet. Outlets Pew did not ask about have no 'pew' entry and stay Unplaced. Add or remove outlets in the open, with a changelog entry.

_note_sections: Section feeds (health, science, climate) checked live on 2026-10-18. Guardian and BBC sections left out: mostly UK and global, and they would add about 50 left-leaning items a scan. Fox Science, CBS Science and NPR Climate were stale; the WSJ science feed was dead.

changelog.change: Removed Texas Tribune (unplaced): it has refused the scanner with HTTP 403 since launch. Considered Newsmax as a right-leaning replacement (Pew 2025: 15% Rep, 1% Dem), but it drops the scanner's connection when it identifies itself; we do not disguise the scanner, so it is not added.
Added section feeds (health, science, climate) for NPR, New York Times, ABC News, CBS News, Fox News, New York Post and Breitbart; see _note_sections.

Added a second placement source, AllSides, for outlets Pew did not survey. Placed Washington Examiner (Lean Right) and Vox (Left); added Washington Times, National Review, Daily Caller and Washington Free Beacon (all right-leaning by AllSides). Right side goes from 3 to 8 outlets, left from 10 to 11.

Added three right-leaning outlets placed by AllSides (current pages, not low confidence): The Dispatch (Lean Right), Daily Mail US (Lean Right), The Epoch Times (Lean Right, borderline Center). Considered and not added: The Free Press (rating disputed), The Daily Signal (AllSides low confidence), Townhall, Reason and The Federalist (no current AllSides rating found). Right side: 11 outlets listed.

Added right-leaning health, science and environment section feeds (checked live): Daily Mail Health and Science & Tech; The Epoch Times Health, Science, Environment; Washington Examiner Healthcare and Energy & Environment. Left-leaning outlets had most of the topic sections, so the new topics were thin on the right. Checked and not available: Fox Science (stale since 2026-09-27), Daily Caller, Daily Wire and National Review health or energy feeds.

Removed Washington Times: its Cloudflare protection refuses data-center traffic, so every scan from GitHub's servers got HTTP 403 (it answers home connections, and its robots.txt does not forbid us). We do not route around blocks. It never counted toward the right side, since only working outlets count; removing it stops the site listing it as unreachable on every scan.

Checked the right-leaning outlets on AllSides Media Bias Chart v12 (2026). Placed Reason (Center) and The Federalist (Right) from the chart. Added Just the News (Lean Right), The Free Press (Lean Right), OAN (Right), IJR (Right). Left out: The American Spectator and The American Conservative (opinion magazines; no left opinion magazines are read either), ZeroHedge (mostly reposts and commentary), and The Post Millennial, CBN, Fox Business, Upward News (no working feed).

Added four left-leaning outlets to match the right side at 15: NBC News (Pew 2025: 24% Rep, 47% Dem), Axios (Lean Left), HuffPost (Left), TIME (Lean Left), the last three from AllSides chart v12. Checked and not added: Washington Post (feeds return server errors), USA Today (402), AP and Yahoo News (403), opinion magazines (The Atlantic, The New Yorker, The Nation, Jacobin). Working but not added: The Daily Beast, Semafor, CNBC, Insider.

_note_allsides: Outlets Pew did not survey are placed from AllSides Media Bias Ratings (allsides.com), read from each outlet's AllSides page on 2026-10-19: Left and Lean Left are left-leaning, Center is center, Lean Right and Right are right-leaning. AllSides is a category, not a number, so these outlets count fully toward their side but are not drawn on the Pew audience chart. Ratings AllSides itself marks as low confidence are not used (TheBlaze). Reason and The Federalist have no current AllSides page we could verify, so they stay Unplaced.
